ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew the then-current Term, for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.

input.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the post-Initial Term notice window from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days and confirmed it operates as a non-renewal election, since our playbook allows automatic twelve-month renewals only with an exit on 30 days' notice (60 days at the outside). We can live with 60 days if that is easier for you.
input.summary: Shorten non-renewal/termination notice window after Initial Term from 90 to 30 days
